source.text: Your groceries are ordered for Sunday. The delivery window is 10:00 to 12:00, and someone needs to be home to receive the box. The order has 14 items and comes to about ¥8,200. Two items were out of stock, so I swapped in the closest match and listed both swaps in the order. Nothing else changed from your usual list. I'll remind you on Saturday evening.
